pattern: The two cheapest winners (Carousel - reviews, Static - 15% off returning, $30.68 and $30.77) run to warm retargeting audiences and open on a number or a greeting; the two prospecting winners (Static - before/after, Static - serum hero, $40.00 each) lead with one concrete outcome.
The one loser, New Sales Ad ($81.85 a purchase), has no angle: 'Shop our skincare' under Meta's default headline, with quality ranked BELOW_AVERAGE_20.
